lawyer:
Mr. M.A. Abdus Satter ----- for Applicant 
Mr. Dabiruddin Ahmed, D.A.G. ----- for Respondent
parties:
Sunderban Textile Mills
Vs.
The Commissioner of Taxes
full_judgment: 3. The Reference Application No. 14/93 relates' to the assessment year 1986-97 and the asessee disclosed net profit of Taka 2,78,17,766/- which however, was assessed at Taka 2,95,35,926/- by the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes including an income of Taka 94,18,413/- from other sources other than the income derived from commercial operation. The Deputy Commissioner of Taxes allowed exemption on the amount of Taka 2,01,17,912 being the business income on the ground of Tax Holiday facility available to the assessee but levied income Tax on Taka 94,18,143/- as the said income was from other sources, which includes interest income of Taka 90,17,163/- received from Bank on fixed deposit.
